correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the recursive block-deletion encoding on S_n=[1,n-1]. For any block B containing n-1, C=S_n\B, m=|C|+1, recursively construct the top m-element algebra, adjoin x_m as a new smallest invariant, and use strictly increasing row-output indices b in B\{n-1} in the UNIQUE published extension formula. Inverting via the maximal non-unit invariant m, its strict row-output set A and compressed top algebra proves a bijection for all n by induction. Every appended block adds exactly one non-unit invariant; Properzi–Qin Theorem 4.3 makes its upper-set a distinct proper nonempty ideal. Thus the ideal histogram is S(n-1,k), including n=1 and k=0. The source verify.py actual recursion, L-cycloid check, direct raw-table comparison n<=5, ideal-axiom subset enumeration n<=6 and partition tests n<=8 were read; these bounded scripts are corroboration, not the universal proof. Essential published hypotheses and extension lemma were checked in Dietzel–Menchón–Vendramin Prop4.4/Theorem4.5 and ideal theorem in Properzi–Qin.
